name: sentry_list_issues
description: List Sentry error issues. Filter by status (unresolved/resolved/ignored), project, and query string.

name: sentry_get_issue
description: Get full details of a specific Sentry error issue by ID

name: sentry_update_issue
description: Update a Sentry issue — change status, assign to a team member, or mark as seen

name: sentry_resolve_issue
description: Mark a Sentry error issue as resolved

name: sentry_ignore_issue
description: Ignore a Sentry error issue so it doesn't appear in the default view

name: sentry_delete_issue
description: Permanently delete a Sentry error issue

name: sentry_list_issue_events
description: List individual error events for a specific Sentry issue — each event is one occurrence with stack trace

name: sentry_get_latest_event
description: Get the most recent occurrence of a Sentry issue with full stack trace and context

name: sentry_list_project_events
description: List recent error events for a Sentry project with optional query filter

name: sentry_list_projects
description: List all Sentry projects in the organization

name: sentry_get_project
description: Get details about a specific Sentry project

name: sentry_get_project_stats
description: Get event statistics (received, rejected, blacklisted) for a Sentry project over a time range

name: sentry_list_releases
description: List releases in Sentry for a project, showing which version each error was first seen in

name: sentry_create_release
description: Create a new release in Sentry to track which errors are introduced or fixed per deployment

name: sentry_finalize_release
description: Mark a Sentry release as deployed and live

name: sentry_list_alert_rules
description: List alert rules configured for a Sentry project

name: sentry_get_org_stats
description: Get organization-wide error volume statistics from Sentry
